notes.title: Switching to Free To Play
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

as you can see by the title Shootball Arena is going to become free in May.
I'll try to briefly explain the reason why we had to take this decision.

Our initial idea was to enter early access at a very cheap price, put in more content until the official release and so in the meantime increasing the price step by step: that's what we did at first.
But sometimes you have to deal with unconfortable numbers and after analysing some data refering to our first month in early access it turns out that something is not working at all: Shootball Arena is an hybrid game that make it complicated to define a target audience and furthermore all similar games are free on Steam ( and other stores ) with a lot more content ( they are on the market for a while now ); for this reason, even if the game is absolutely worth the price, we have no choice but to comply with the market.

Unfortunately some of you have already bought the game and while on the one hand we are really proud on the other hand we are very sorry of that: Steam policy allows you to get a refund and there is nothing we can do but apologize and thank you ( at least the price was very cheap :).

The Shootball Arena team.

notes.title: 8 April: early access is coming.
notes.content:
Hello,
following our plan to release more and more content here we are with a new update.

A gang of bikers is joining the arena: riding their motorbikes they can't carry too much weight of course, but the small SMG and the short barrel shotgun they can choose from are extremely dangerous indeed... I'm pretty sure some players will find a way to make good use of both. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41648670/46bb33259033f6e82584ab4abb7dff2050d9915a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41648670/f668677981515233415c3adf46e77d4ccbe84b22.png[/img]

Looking at the image above you will find that we also added the nickname over the player's head... at least now you can read who's beating you :). Of course you will be able to switch on/off this feature in the option menu ( about the option menu, it is still in alpha stage and needs more work to be completed, so don't worry if you can see only few options at the moment ).

So, let's recap some features: 
[list]
[*] online match up to 6 players ( will be 10 in the final release )
[*] 3 different arenas
[*] 8 characters 
[*] 6 weapons
[*] 2 passive and 3 active powerups 
[*] super shot by hitting the ball with the right timing while jumping
[*] offline training mode to become familiar with controls
[/list]

Having this new update ready to go we finally reached the point where we have enough content to take the next step and let you have lots of fun playing shootball and help us make the best game we can thanks to your valuable feedback.

So, ta-daaaa! We are pleased to announce that we are entering early access on 8 April :).

More is coming, stay connected.

The Shootball Arena team.

notes.title: New contents and some improvement
notes.content:
Hi everyone,
we have released a new arena called Desert: it's in the warm desert ( but I guess this was already clear :) and it's the largest one at the moment ( we are almost ready for 3vs3... soon after the early access ).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41648670/c3b493e590235f42684a6a89bf909a27f6eeaeb5.png[/img]

You can also find a new female character, Makoto; she is very fast and can choose between two new weapons: a nail gun and something like a big trumpet ( I don't know exactly, ask our concept artist please :).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41648670/0ffec202f4ad0e3825daea97d76f3e387951b283.png[/img]
Makoto is playing in the new map.

Now, changing the subject, we are working on stats and leaderboards: playing the game you will gain experience points; the more you win, the more your rank increases.

Some players who are trying the game in preview are complaining that you can only sprint straight forward; indeed they are right, so we have removed such a constraint ( thanks for your feedback guys, very appreciated ).

Last but not least we have increased the fire range of all weapons: it's mandatory to find a good balancing to prevent players shooting from one goal line to the other.

That's all for today folks.

See you soon,
the Shootball Arena team.

notes.title: Restyling and new features
notes.content:
Hi, 
those who follow us may have noticed that we have replaced the gameplay footage and all the pictures in the landing page with better ones... we hope :). The reason is that we have restyling all the characters from scratch, moving from the old cartoonish to a new semi-realistic style which in our opinion better suit the rest of the game ( at this point you may wonder why on Earth we chose a cartonish style for our characters in the first place, but please... don't ask... really don't :).

[previewyoutube=81fsRFHGKdg;full][/previewyoutube]
In addition we are also working to improve game mechanics more and more, so we added two main features here:
[list]
[*]Super shot
[*]Power ups
[/list]

[h3]Super shot[/h3]
The super shot is.... a super shot. Ok, I guess I should give you some more detail here. Watching the video you can see your crosshair shaking at a certain point while you are jumping: shooting in that very moment your weapon power increases by about three times and hitting the ball  you get the super shot... and a wonderful flaming ball indeed.

[h3]Power ups[/h3]
Power ups give the gameplay more depth being able to be used in many different ways: for example you can throw the magnet to avoid an opponent's goal or lift the ball and get ready for the super shot. Power ups randomly appear in the arena and refresh on goal or every 30 seconds ( if I'm not wrong ).
Here are the ones we made so far, others will be added in the future:

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41648670/5c705130b3888ca84bed0f98cf275a97a1490dd8.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41648670/a6198e863c01e58b4fba849e0804958163f44385.png[/img][/url] Passive, increases your character skills
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41648670/3426f3233c175b7f633a3adf0cdd956595b5cad1.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41648670/6db96dc74740299519d71c3cddff6361cab5fcbe.png[/img][/url] Passive, increases your current weapon stats
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41648670/158d05e1f432eeaf773cb921e701dafae5aced9a.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41648670/615d94f1bf20434c3bb9b17770df961ffbfd493f.png[/img][/url] Active, makes a wall appear on the field
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41648670/eab7e7ec621e93aa0cb8adf137c9393d9a8e0027.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41648670/195d3d7edd84aa087d9a94401016c8cdf2b5ed9d.png[/img][/url] Active, throws a grenade freezing all the opponent players in a given range
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41648670/a75586b5a59b04666c2ace602f6019d35edcc54a.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41648670/e98a883950ab49d273584582ec827ec68dc2d942.png[/img][/url] Active, attracts the ball

At the very moment we are working on the third arena and some other characters, in order for you to have enough content to enjoy with and for us to take the next step: early access is coming soon.... yeah :)

That's all for today folks.

Stay tuned and be ready,
the Shootball Arena team.
